settings.helper: How many Reviv appliances have you bought before? Returning customers pay a reduced price on R2 and R3.

settings.title: New to Reviv
settings.text: The low-cut profile is the easiest of the three to sleep in, so most people start here rather than with R1 or R2.

settings.title: Sensitive gums
settings.text: R3 sits lower on the gum line and applies the least pressure of any Reviv appliance.

settings.title: Long-term nightly use
settings.text: Built to be worn every night for about a year, plus a few hours during the day when you can.

settings.toc_title: More health issues than ever before
settings.title: People today are having more physical and mental health issues than ever before
settings.items:
Postural issues
Depression and anxiety
Chronic fatigue and poor energy
ADHD, OCD and similar
Obesity
settings.caption: Reported growth in physical and mental health issues, 1950–2024. Log scale.

settings.title: And the traditional ways of fighting them are falling way short
settings.items:
Pharmaceuticals
Diet and eating healthy
Exercise
Medical procedures

settings.title: So we believe there may be a structural root cause
settings.items:
There is a set of physics that holds the body up, and the teeth play a critical role in it
Because of those physics, the skull can collapse inwards as the teeth change
The health of the skull shows up in the curve of Spee — how the upper and lower teeth meet
Orthodontics, extractions and grinding all flatten that curve
settings.caption: The curve of Spee — how the upper and lower teeth meet.

settings.title: We believe the skull can be inflated like a ball
settings.concept_1_text: What we believe causes aging and asymmetry, and sits at the root of most disease
settings.concept_2_text: Reverses those things — and a mouthguard can help do it
settings.note: As the skull inflates, the curve of Spee improves.

settings.heading: What the appliance actually does
settings.intro: R3 is a simple piece of soft silicone. The idea behind it is what does the work.

settings.title: A simple mouthguard addresses that collapse at its root
settings.items:
The appliance acts like a doorstop that prevents the jaw from closing
That stretches the soft tissue in the mouth and over the skull
As the soft tissue stretches, we believe the skull inflates and the skeleton untwists

settings.title: The teeth correct as a function of the skull correcting
settings.items:
The cranial bones move outwards into better symmetry and the jaw moves to where it should be
The teeth are connected to those bones, so they go for the ride and straighten as a result
The body should function better, and feel stronger and more flexible

settings.title: Root cause of almost all disease
settings.text: Is disease a function of biomechanical collapse?

settings.title: Root cause of aging
settings.text: If we do not collapse, maybe we do not age the way we assume we must.

settings.title: Root cause of beauty
settings.text: How far does this go if you take it all the way?

settings.name: Medium
settings.text: Teens and adults with smaller mouths. Slightly narrower and shorter for a more precise fit.

settings.name: Large
settings.text: Suits most adults, and gives a snug, comfortable fit for best effect.

settings.name: XL
settings.text: For adults with larger mouths. New with R3 — it was not available before.

settings.title: Unbox and rinse
settings.text: Take it out of the box and wash it under running water before the first wear.

settings.title: Wear it overnight, plus daytime
settings.text: Sleep in it every night and add 2–3 hours during the day. Build up in short intervals at first.

settings.title: Wash and let it dry
settings.text: Rinse after every use and air-dry. Keep it away from hot water and direct sunlight.

settings.title: 1 week
settings.items:
Some initial discomfort in the teeth and gums
A few nights to get used to sleeping with it

settings.title: 1 month
settings.items:
It starts to feel more comfortable
Differences in how the teeth fit together
Many wake without the tight, clenched feeling

settings.title: 1 year
settings.items:
Better concentration and stamina, many report
More energy through the day

settings.title: 2 years+
settings.items:
The appliance plateaus; the community stretches carry it on
Steady improvement, functionally and aesthetically

settings.question: How should I start? Is there anything to be aware of?
settings.answer: The standard pattern is overnight plus 2–3 hours during the day. Build up gradually with shorter daytime intervals first rather than going straight to overnights — that helps the soft tissue adjust. Most people find the first few weeks the hardest part, and it gets significantly easier after that.
